name: colors
title: Colors
description: A colour picker for the keyboard: pick a pixel off the screen, type any notation, or walk hue and lightness with the arrows, then copy the colour in any notation. Also named palettes as swatch grids, a history and a converter.
author: pal

settings.label: Copy as
settings.description: The notation `c` and Copy write; every other notation stays a keystroke away in the picker and the action panel.

settings.label: Alpha
settings.description: What a translucent colour writes: the alpha kept (`#ff880080`, `rgba(…)`, `/ 0.5`) or dropped, so every copy is opaque.

options.title: Drop it, copy the opaque colour

settings.label: Sets shown
settings.description: Which named sets the grid lists under All: css, tailwind, material3, material, apple, catppuccin, rosepine, nord, solarized, pal. The filter dropdown still reaches every set.

settings.label: History size
settings.description: How many picked and copied colours the history keeps, newest first, one entry per colour.

store.tagline: Pick, type or walk a colour, then copy it in any notation
features: Pick a pixel off the screen with the system's loupe; the Pick Colour row copies it straight away
Every notation at once (hex, rgb, hsl, oklch, lab, display-p3, CSS name), plus contrast with AA/AAA badges
Arrows walk hue and lightness, `-` and `+` saturation; `m` switches between HSL and OKLCH
Tints, shades and harmonies as tiles to pick from
Named palettes as swatch grids: CSS, Tailwind, Material, Apple, Catppuccin, Rosé Pine, Nord, Solarized
A history of every colour you picked or copied, and a converter for any notation

screenshots.caption: The picker: the swatch over the hue strip and the plane, every notation, the nearest tokens, contrast, tints, shades and harmonies
Tab onto the shades: the arrows walk the row, the label names the tile, Enter takes it
Typing a notation: a digit or # opens the field in the search row, Enter applies it
The named sets as swatch grids, one section per set, a filter per set
The history: every picked and copied colour with when and where from, and the screen pick at the top
Convert Colour: hsl(30 100% 50%) as hex first, then every notation and the nearest CSS name; the pane has the contrast on white and black

actions.title: Copy
actions.description: The colour in the notation the `format` setting names; `cmd+c` always copies the hex.

actions.title: Pick Colour from Screen
actions.description: Hides the panel and shows the system's loupe; the picked colour comes back into the picker (or, from the root row, onto the clipboard).

actions.title: Walk the colour
actions.description: Hue on left/right, lightness on up/down, saturation or chroma on - and +; shift makes the step three to five times bigger.

actions.title: Type a notation
actions.description: A digit or # opens the text field with that character; Enter applies, Escape closes it.

actions.title: Focus a row of tiles
actions.description: Tab moves the focus from the swatch to the tints, the shades and each harmony; the arrows walk the row and Enter uses the tile.

actions.title: Open in Picker
actions.description: From a set tile, a history entry or a converter row: the picker on that colour.

picker.title: Colour Picker
picker.description: The colour under the keys: every notation, tints, shades, harmonies, contrast and the nearest tokens; `p` picks from the screen, a digit types a notation.

keys.title: Copy rgb (h hsl, o oklch, l lab, p display-p3, n the CSS name)
Edit in HSL or in OKLCH
Type a notation into the search row; Enter applies, Escape closes
Focus the next / previous row of tiles; arrows walk it, Enter uses the tile

colors.title: Named Colours
colors.description: The named sets as swatch tiles, one section per set, a filter per set; recently opened tiles first.

keys.title: The detail pane: notations, contrast, where the token is used

settings.label: Columns
settings.description: Tiles per row in the grid.

history.title: Colour History
history.description: Every picked and copied colour, newest first, with when and where from; Pick Colour from Screen at the top.

keys.title: Open in Picker (on the top row: pick from the screen)

convert.title: Convert Colour
convert.description: Type a colour in any notation; the rows are its conversions. Enter opens the picker on it. At the root a hex, a function notation or a CSS name answers inline under a Convert Colour section.
